title: 3800万呎农地：北部都会区，最大赢家？
speaker: Andrew Fong

segments.en: We still own 38 million square feet.
segments.zh: 我们仍持有3800万平方英尺的农地。

segments.en: So it really depends on how the government planned the large metropolitan.
segments.zh: 所以这取决于政府如何规划这个大型都会区。

segments.en: Those resumptions, we got close to the university town.
segments.zh: 那些收地项目，我们靠近大学城。

segments.en: And also recently we also have paid a land PM in a JV to convert a piece of land, which is also close to the university town.
segments.zh: 最近我们也在合资项目中支付了土地前期费用，转换一块同样靠近大学城的土地。

segments.en: So after all, the government is the drive. And also we have to follow.
segments.zh: 毕竟政府是驱动力，我们也必须跟随。

segments.en: The reason the development is quite, it's start to be currified and quite encouraging.
segments.zh: 发展开始变得清晰且令人鼓舞。

segments.en: You see the pilot area, we also tend to bid in the pilot area, which will be a combination of residential, commercial, and logistic.
segments.zh: 你看试点区域，我们也倾向于竞标，那里将集住宅、商业和物流于一体。

segments.en: And also you see the government has a piece of land in Sarland, which is a data center.
segments.zh: 政府在新界有一块地用于数据中心。

segments.en: So a lot of metropolitan is starting to have some formations.
segments.zh: 所以许多都会区开始形成规模。

segments.en: So for us, of course, if they have to assume some land for public interest, we just follow should.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，如果政府需要征收土地用于公共利益，我们只能配合。

segments.en: But we are choosing, as you mentioned, we try to choose some of our lands, which is close to the imminent developments.
segments.zh: 但正如你所说，我们会选择那些靠近即将开发区域的农地。

segments.en: Well, I guess the land banking in the past did help.
segments.zh: 我想过去的土地储备确实有帮助。

segments.en: Yes, it's a good problem to have.
segments.zh: 是的，这是个甜蜜的烦恼。
